passage:
retention — 记忆保持；保留
However, critics noted that the survey did not measure long-term retention.

peer — 同龄人；同伴
Team B presented "Social Learning Cycles." According to this theory, adults learn best through structured group discussion and peer feedback.

segmented — 分段的；分割的
Participants who received the segmented lesson completed the task faster than those who received the full lesson at once.

self-regulation — 自我调节
Team D proposed "Self-Regulation Emphasis." They argued that adults learn best when they set their own goals, monitor their progress, and adjust their strategies.

complementary — 互补的
Some argued that the theories were complementary rather than competing.

collaborative — 合作的
The conference ended with a plan for a collaborative follow-up project, which would combine elements from all four theories.

biased — 有偏见的
Critics pointed out that the study relied on self-report, which can be biased.

persistence — 坚持；毅力
While the journals did not directly measure learning outcomes, the team suggested that confidence may support persistence.
